_comment: User-approved roster additions (2026-07-23 Bulbapedia completeness audit; scope: partner pools + edge cases included, manga excluded). Merged into rosters_raw by map_species.py at map time so re-scrapes cannot silently drop them. Also carries user-directed additions made after that audit: Oak gains Dratini (Dragonite) and Rotom, both from the anime (2026-07-24). Also: Pike Queen Lucy's six Pokemon 'at home' from the anime (Abra, Snorlax, Cyndaquil, Swinub, Makuhita, Skitty), which sit inside a TrainerPoke desc and were missed by the owner-scoped extraction (user-corrected 2026-07-25). Provenance: ../../..//approved_roster_additions_2026-07-23.json
